# Corpus round-trip manifest. One entry per line, '#' starts a comment:
#   <path relative to tests/fixtures/excel> <stage|*> <detail|*> <kind>  # reason
# stage: load, save_xlsx, save_xlsb, reload_xlsx, reload_xlsb, model_xlsx, model_xlsb,
#        validate_xlsx, validate_xlsb. detail: numeric error code, model field or rule name.
# kinds:
#   excel_refuses                 Excel refuses the source; marker only (`*` `*`), accepts nothing.
#   mirrors_excel_refused_source  exact validate_* rule failure that carries the source's invalid
#                                 value through; the path must also have an excel_refuses line.
#   save_refused                  exact save_* stage + numeric code the engine refuses by design.
#   known_gap                     exact stage + detail of a failure that is owed a fix.
#   damaged                       deliberately damaged control (`*` `*`); every failure is accepted.
# An exact entry whose failure no longer occurs fails the test: remove the entry.
win/book_protection/hand_lockWindows_afterWorkbookPr.rejected.input.xlsx * * excel_refuses  # Excel refuses the source (-50)
xlsb_parity/format/base_256_src.xlsx * * excel_refuses  # Excel refuses the source (-50)
